title: 8 Week Hiking Training Plan Printable, Beginner Hiker Workout, No Gym, Get Fit for Hiking, Hike Prep Planner, Training Log PDF
description:
Have a bigger hike coming up, like a park trip, a first 10-miler or a summit? This 28-page printable plan gets you ready in eight weeks without a gym. You only need good shoes, a daypack, some stairs or a hill, and a chair.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Who the plan is for, what you need, and a quick self-check before you start
- How it works: five short sessions a week (walks, hikes and strength days), with easier and harder options
- Warm-up and cool-down routine
- Strength moves for hikers: step-ups, squats to a chair, lunges, calf raises, glute bridge and plank, each with an easier and a harder version
- Weeks 1 to 8, one page each: daily sessions, pack weight build-up in lb and kg, distances in miles and km, and a tip of the week
- The week 8 dress rehearsal hike
- Going downhill kindly on your knees, food and water on training hikes, and sore vs hurt
- Weekly training logs, a progress tracker, a pre-trip checklist and a trip-day plan to leave with someone

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
General fitness information, not medical advice. If you have health concerns, talk to your doctor before starting a new exercise plan. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
